reason: A Telegram protocol adapter that connects authorized Telegram chats to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, forwarding text messages and streamed assistant responses through the Telegram Bot API.

summaries.zh: 通过 Telegram Bot API 将获授权的聊天连接到 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话，并转发文本消息与助手回复。
summaries.en: Connects authorized Telegram chats to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and forwards text messages and assistant responses through the Telegram Bot API.

capabilities: Sends assistant text messages to Telegram chats
Creates and follows agent sessions for allowed chats
Uses a configured Telegram bot token and user allowlist
